svg.text: The collaboration plane: keep the cohort, prune the conversation
Substantial scientific execution needs at least two epistemically independent contributions, and that is an epistemic requirement rather than
a capability one — a cost argument cannot answer it. So the cohort is fixed and the conversation is optimised. Everything below is a way of
spending fewer tokens without losing the second look.
1 · Independence is a profile, not a count
did it see the other first
Five instances of one model on one context are ONE contribution. They will agree, and the agreement carries no information — which is why a
cohort of identical profiles is refused and a cohort of three differentiated ones passes. ACC-081.
2 · Independent-first — the order is the mechanism
Anchoring is an effect, not a preference: an actor shown a confident prior answer converges on it, and the record afterwards shows two agreeing
actors — indistinguishable from two that independently agreed. The seal is the only thing that tells them apart later. A majority cannot close a
3 · What crosses an edge, and what never does
Ten message types, because a CHALLENGE can be tracked to
resolution and a paragraph cannot. The message carries the change and
a digest; the content goes to the artifact store. Delete the blackboard and
no canonical science is lost — ACC-084, ACC-085.
A full reasoning transcript passed between agents is a channel through
which one agent's error becomes another's premise. The token saving is
the obvious reason to refuse it; that is the other one.
4 · What budget pressure degrades — and the floor it cannot cross
The floor: what budget may never reach
The cohort. The assurance route. Any non-waivable control. A BLOCKER or a safety message at any utility threshold. A task that cannot afford
its required assurance is BLOCKED_BUDGET or asks for a scope reduction — it does not proceed more cheaply. ACC-088, ACC-099,
5 · The optimisation is anchored, or it is not an optimisation
Accepted only when quality stays inside a declared tolerance and coordination cost falls meaningfully. A regression rolls the topology back
automatically. The baseline is the naive fully-connected cohort — not a single agent, because comparing to one agent measures the cost of having a
cohort at all, which is a decision already taken on other grounds. ACC-086, ACC-087.
6 · Everything above is policy; underneath it is a replaceable substrate
Identities, rooms, message transport, presence and runtime attachment are not scientific work and are adopted behind a CollaborationBackend
contract — ADR-020, with Buzz as the first candidate. The substrate makes one thing very easy, and that one thing is the failure: put every actor in a
shared room and rows 2, 3 and 4 above are all undone at once.
a room is not the blackboard, and history is not
A backend that cannot hold round-zero peers apart, or cannot materialise a sparse graph without accidental all-to-all visibility, fails qualification and the
task does not run. The topology is never relaxed to fit a backend — WP-148-T11.
Status: none of this is built. WP-148 to WP-150 and WP-153 specify it; there is no cohort record, no blackboard, no topology compiler, no governor, no
backend adapter and no baseline harness to measure any of it against.
